Unpopular opinion: Witcher 3 combat is bad.

Geralt fights the same way at level 40 as at level 1. Roll, swing, repeat. Signs and alchemy feel optional on normal. Quen solves almost everything. The best writing in RPGs, attached to mediocre combat. Agree?
